description.value:
Freq 1/job

Effect automatically succeeds, no roll, converting a lucky break the party just had into a planned one, and grants a +3 circumstance bonus (Expert) to whatever check exploits it

Retroactively reveal that a seemingly spontaneous advantage was actually pre-arranged by you.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +3 bonus applies to "whatever check exploits it," which may be any party member's check (external target, ambiguous scope) and has no fixed selector -- needs the distracting-feint.json two-file companion-effect pattern plus a fixed-selector answer neither exists here.
